title: Fake AI-Generated Law Firms Sent Fake DMCA Notices to Increase SEO

behaviors.text: In March 2024, fake law firms using AI-generated identities sent fraudulent DMCA takedown notices to [person], demanding backlinks for SEO gains.
These AI-generated law firms, like "Commonwealth Legal," used GAN models for realistic attorney images and fabricated bios.
The scam involved fake legal threats to coerce site [person] into adding backlinks, exploiting AI technology for deceptive practices.
